targets.outcome_reasoning: The new fertility-survey estimates expressly give mixed support to the prior model: predicted attendance and age effects coexist with a contrasting sex difference. Jewish-population estimates broadly support the model. The final general statement about model usefulness is not an unambiguous whole-replication verdict; the original study comparison is somewhat indirect.

reasoning: New survey samples re-test the earlier Azzi and Ehrenberg empirical equations, explicitly identified in footnote 3 as tables 5 and 6. Long and Settle is discussed critically but its data/findings are not directly re-tested; Azzi and Ehrenberg is the protocol actually followed.
